competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, apply only to a subset of items, or be confused with a different exchange or partial-refund policy.
hypothesis_statement: The current return policy for standard items provides a 30-day full-refund return window.
refutation_criterion: Any current authoritative policy source showing that the standard-item full-refund window is not 30 days, or that full refunds are not available within 30 days.
